name: Stanton
role: From New York; with Larry in Saigon
summary: "Stanton is from New York." Larry places him in one of his last Saigon days: "One time in Saigon, I was on a bar on a roof with Zukowski, Stanton and there was war going on all around us. It was one of my last days in Saigon." And after the war, once: "One time Stanton came into my machine shop in LA in western Blvd…" He is not the man in VN-0026; that photograph was first given his name as a guess, and on 2026-09-05 Larry said "This is not Stanton." No photograph of Stanton has been identified.
researchNotes: On 2026-08-15 'Stanton' was a guessed name for the bespectacled soldier in VN-0026 (his son's paraphrase: "A guess name he said is PFC Stanton"); on 2026-09-05 Larry withdrew it (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0026-c18308443.json) and the same day, on VN-0081, gave Stanton a hometown, a scene and a post-war visit (giscus-vn-0081-c18308075.json). Corrected 2026-09-14 after research/site-audit-2026-09-14.md: this record had called him a soldier in Larry's unit and a friend Larry kept after the war. Larry has said neither; he describes one visit to his shop. Whether they were in the same unit, and how Stanton knew where to find the shop, are open. The visit may be traceable in Larry's own papers or address books; ask the family before any roster search. The rooftop scene is undated and unplaced and is left as given.
